q: Which expression checks that n (> 0) is a power of two?
why: A power of two has exactly one set bit; clearing it leaves 0.

q: Why is `n & 1 == 0` a bug in Python?

q: Counting Bits for 0..n in O(n): ans[i] = …
why: i >> 1 is i without its last bit (already computed), plus that last bit.

q: Enumerate all subsets of a 4-element set without recursion. How?

why: Each of the 2⁴ masks is exactly one subset.
